summary: The initial RNG mismatch came from planned poison clouds, not dogmove.c:dog_goal. A future planned iron-golem breath called zap_over_floor and activated gas regions; block_point rebuilt the shared transparency index from the planning clone, hiding the coin from later pet visibility checks. zap_over_floor now admits that planned vision change before creating the cloud, and planSimpleMonsterTurn passes the callback into movemon_singlemon. The v83 replay now has no RNG divergence and first differs later on screen at step 859.

source.branch: In zap_over_floor(), the ZT_POISON_GAS arm runs when ZAP_POS(lev->typ) accepts the traversed floor square. During monster-action planning, poison breath may create a cloud on the cloned level; creating the region calls block_point(), which rebuilds vision.c’s module-wide transparency index. The planning pass must mark that borrowed index before the mutation so preflightSimpleMonsterActions() restores it from the live level in its finally block.
callers: mon.c:movemon_singlemon enters the ordered monster scan; monmove.c:dochug can select the iron-golem breath action, which reaches mthrowu.c:breamu/breamm, zap.c:dobuzz, and zap.c:zap_over_floor. The planning caller in js/unported_monster_actions.js now passes admitPlannedVisionChange through movemon_singlemon so the ZT_POISON_GAS branch marks the borrowed vision index before adding its region.
zap.c:dobuzz also calls zap_over_floor for ordinary ray traversal and deferred gas-cloud placement; only planned callers need the vision-admission callback.

evidence: The promoted v83 queue records 1351 steps, 1350 matching screens, all 1351 cursors matching, 3421/3425 RNG calls, and one remaining screen. At segment 0, step 598 (key .), C records rn2(8)=6 at dog_goal(dogmove.c:554), while JavaScript records rn2(4)=2; the first screen mismatch appears at step 859.

Prep’s same-input observer at .cache/prep47-recovery/prep83/logs/rust-goal-observer-v3.json confirms the replay matches all RNG, screens and cursors through step 597. At the pet located (17,15), hero (18,16), and coin (15,16), all eligibility guards agree while petCanSee changes from 1 on the first planning pass to 0 on later planning/live scans.

Prep’s temporary zap.js caller trace at .cache/prep47-recovery/prep83/logs/rust-cloud-caller-trace.log shows six poison-cloud calls with planning:true and state._plannedVisionChange:null; the C/JS mismatch remains at RNG 2832 / step 598. The trace only read state before each call and did not replace behavior.

C zap.c:zap_over_floor() lines 5141 onward handles ZT_POISON_GAS by calling create_gas_cloud(x,y,1,8) when ZAP_POS(lev->typ) succeeds, then breaks. C region.c:create_gas_cloud() creates a region and make_gas_cloud() adds it; the JavaScript add_region caller invokes blockPoint while adding gas clouds. JavaScript zap.js currently passes raw blockPoint and does not call the existing planned-vision admission callback first.

JavaScript unported_monster_actions.js:admitPlannedVisionChange() clones vision buffers and marks _plannedVisionChange; preflightSimpleMonsterActions() restores the shared transparency index from the live state in a finally block only when that marker exists. The existing createMonsterGasCloud() helper demonstrates the required planning admission pattern for other cloud callers.

The current first cause is not dogmove.c:dog_goal(): that source path is where C’s next rn2(8) is consumed after the poisoned planning state has already hidden the coin. Later intended monster death/rust behavior is outside the first mismatch.

The post-fix v83 replay completes without a planner refusal or RNG divergence. It matches through step 858; its first remaining screen divergence is segment 0, step 859 (key space). The admitted case therefore verifies the planned iron-golem breath path only through step 858; the later screen difference remains outside this fix.

source.branch: When gas_cloud_diss_seen is nonzero, run_regions calls You_see("%s gas cloud%s dissipate.", ...). pline.c:You_see selects "You sense" when Blind is true.

javaScript.branch: The gas_cloud_diss_seen branch hardcodes "You see a gas cloud dissipate." or its plural and does not apply the hero blindness prefix.

followupInvestigation.observation: At step 859, run_regions emitted the gas-cloud dissipation message after a callback made the hero blind. C printed “You sense a gas cloud dissipate.”; JavaScript printed “You see a gas cloud dissipate.” The differing first character at column 6 was caused by JavaScript bypassing pline.c:You_see, not by RNG or cursor behavior.
followupInvestigation.rootCause: region.c:run_regions passes the formatted line to You_see, which selects “You sense” when Blind is true and “You dream that you see” when Unaware is true. The JavaScript run_regions branch hard-coded the “You see” prefix. It now calls the existing js/monmove.js:youSee helper with the current game state; that helper implements pline.c:You_see and gives Unaware precedence over Blind.
followupInvestigation.status: implemented and replay-verified through segment 0, step 859; the screen, cursor and RNG streams match through the formerly divergent message.
